user_input: What is the two-hop relationship from LockBit affiliates through Advanced Internet Protocol (IP) Scanner to an ATT&CK technique in this advisory? Explain both the software-use link and the technique mapping.
response:
LockBit affiliates use Advanced Port Scanner to scan target networks. [E10, E11, E13]
Advanced Port Scanner performs network scans, finding open TCP and UDP ports for exploitation. [E1, E2, E3]
Network Service Discovery (T1046) is the ATT&CK technique used by LockBit affiliates. [E4, E13]
Network Segmentation (M1030) is the mitigation for Network Service Discovery (T1046). [E4, E5]
Network Segmentation (M1030) involves ensuring proper network segmentation to protect critical servers and devices. [E4, E5]
